title: Audit Rust and UI tests for remaining wall-clock bounds that fail under load (assert elapsed time, fixed deadlines, timer windows)
outcome: Audit Rust and UI tests for remaining wall-clock bounds that fail under load (assert elapsed time, fixed deadlines, timer windows)
acceptance: A recorded list, with file:line, of every test whose pass/fail depends on wall-clock time under load: an elapsed or median bound, a fixed deadline inside the code under test that the test races, or a 'not yet due' window. Each entry is classified as safe (the bound is a product requirement, or there is ample margin) or at-risk, with the reason.
Each at-risk test is filed as its own item that measures the real property (work done, ordering, an injected clock) instead of time. This audit does not change code itself.
Known cases already owned are cross-referenced and not re-filed: w-043ee952978f, w-2b87f743dde6, w-707ad5e437d5.
